description: Source code defining the Groq_ChatModels class, a node implementation for integrating Groq API chat models within a larger system. It includes imports, class properties, constructor, loadMethods, and init function.

classes.name: Groq_ChatModels
classes.description: A class implementing INode, representing a chat model node for Groq API with properties for configuration, methods for loading models, and initialization logic.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains an asynchronous method listModels that retrieves available chat models from the Groq API.

methods.name: init
